My wife's mashed potatoes were cold. She said her tri-tip was ok. My burger that was supposed to be well done was well done in some places and medium in others. I didn't eat it. We told the waiter about the mashed potatoes. He brought some more out that were hot. The manager made no offer to discount the bill for the horrible service and lack-luster food. To put the cap on it, within 3 hours of us leaving the restaurant my wife was vomiting and had an intestinal track that was pretty much trashed. Overpriced and underserviced. Oh, I forgot, the entire restaurant smelled like a sewer when we walked in. The manager said it was because the cold weather outside was bringing the sewer smell inside. It smelled like a very strong gas leak. What an alluring fragrance!

Not one to ever write bad reviews, but this was by FAR the worst Taco Bell I have ever purchased from! I ordered 1 3-layer nachos with just cheese, no red sauce or beans and in replacement of that I asked for extra cheese & was charged 65 cents. Hm, okay whatevs not a big deal just 65 cents right? 1 chicken and cheese quesadilla with creamy jalapeño sauce on side (I'm allergic but the boyfriend likes it!) and 1 crunchy taco! (we like food) I pull up to the window, pay, get my food and drive home. Eagerly pulling into my driveway to go inside and eat my delicious Taco Bell! Come inside, get all the food out and ready to eat. Darn they forgot the boyfriends creamy jalapeño sauce. Oh wait, no they didn't...it's just on the quesadilla! Jerks I can't eat it now thanks. Oh there's hardly any cheese on the nachos, poop didn't they charge me extra for that even though I asked for it in replacement of the sauce and beans? The crunchy taco was the only positive, congrats you earned one star for not screwing up my taco. Justice for the lousy unnecessary 65 cents I was charged for a teaspoon of cheese and forgetting to put the jalapeño sauce on the side!

I just got food poisoned from eating a beef saint paul from this place. I called to discuss the issue with the manager to make them aware of the situation. I was referred to a voicemail box that was full and not accepting any messages. Food safety and contamination doesn't appear to be a priority.

this is by far the the most disgusting places I've ever dined. which is extra scary because they serve raw food. 1. we ordered mussels..they were served in less than 20 seconds. so clearly not fresh.. the reasoning is they were deep fried. they were luke warm and dry. 2. we ordered miso soup with the mussels at the same time, a sweaty dirty waiter came out a couple minutes later and said .so do you still want soup. 3. i visited the co/ed bathroom and it was so dirty !!! so much dirt and hair in the sink and floor it was sickening. 4. more dry and not fresh fish . i tried to talk to the owner and he was argumentative and so extremely rude. I tried to explain my concerns which did not want to hear. i said i was going to have to call the health department with my concerns and did not care a bit saying he had many happy customers. leaving the restaurant there were two different huge stains of vomit. i will def be calling the health department!!

For a gluten free cafe, it was ok. I ordered the French toast, which was delicious. However, I wish they offered a side of fresh fruit and included sides like sweet potatoes or other healthy options that came with the meal instead of having to order them AL LA CARTE. I'd give it a 6/10. Probably won't be returning.

Attention all gluten free consumer, celiac disease people, beware!! Had carrots and parsnips side dish and was unpleasantly surprised to see a noodle in the bottom of the cast iron serving pan. I had it on Saturday night and am still sick. Lost a complete day on Monday (was in bed all day). I still have stomach problems today with stomach and suffering a migraine hangover...anyone who has celiac disease this is not a gluten free friendly place despite the gluten free app...don't go unless you want to be sick...horrible place, manager didn't come over. Waitress had to deal with the issue herself ...I would never, obviously, go back..

I had a taco supreme and there was hair in my taco. Not just one hair but two. There was probably even more. I know it wasnt my hair because my hair is curly and long and the hair I found was short and straight( guys hair). You guys suckkkk. Brb I'm going to vomit. I want my $4.26 back lol

I ordered online a vegetarian pizza with gluten free crust, to be delivered. It was the worst pizza I ever tried to eat. The crust was burned, it only came in small (thank goodness for that because it was awful). It cost me $19.99 plus a $5 tip. It had almost no veggies on it - some chili and a wedge of tomato was about it. I don't understand how someone in business could send that pizza out the door and expect to survive as a restaurant. $25 for a small, vegetable sparse pizza, almost no cheese. This was very disappointing food.

I've ordered here *frequently* through Postmates, DoorDash, etc. I've gone in to the restaurant tons of times. People seemed nice, reliably solid burger. Reliably solid, that is, if you have their aioli white sauce. The first time I ordered from here, they included it on the side. Great! So ordered delivery from there again, including a note in the comments to make sure to include it. Only, this time? Didn't include it. Ok. Next time? I'm sure it was a mistake, let's give it another shot. Make sure to ask them nicely in the comments of the order, and offer to pay extra for it if need be. Is it in there? Nope. This happens enough that I finally call them and complain--am I like, offending you by requesting this stuff or something? It's a side, part of the order. Is it like, deliberate to withhold it or am I being crazy? She's apologetic, refunds the order. Ok. Soon thereafter my girlfriend orders from there, gets violently ill. Food poisoning, from them, for sure. Tonight I figured I would order delivery, really wanted a burger. Let's do Burger Up. Asked nicely in the comments for it. Order arrives, I open 'er up--two sides of neatly packaged ketchup and that's it. Wouldn't including this stuff be as automatic as the sides of their awful house ketchup? Or the totally useless pickle? I gotta hope I'm lucky enough to get a side of this stuff, even though it is literally a necessity in making it worth ordering from there? So I called, asked for my money back. Guy puts me on hold for 20 minutes before some idiot named Troy tells me the best he can do is a gift card. I said I wanted my money back. "You ordered through Postmates, so, sorry." So ok, I think, now I'm definitely getting my money back. Not only is a gift card extremely lame, the guy lied to my face--a much nicer, more hospitable manager found it easy to do this exact thing. I contacted Postmates, and they offered to refund about $10 out of what came to about $17 total, and the reason they couldn't refund the entire balance was because Burger Up specifically declined to give a refund. It is a B- burger served to you by snotty jerks. Just go somewhere else. I do want to apologize though for my part in insulting the delicate Burger Artistes preparing my order by requesting some of the sauce they offer for my order. That clearly impinged on your creative vision and was super lame of me, man.

This location specifically is not willing to accommodate food allergies. I have an autoimmune disease that causes severe allergies to gluten and eggs. They offer gluten-free bread, but unfortunately it contains egg. I called to inquire about me bringing in my own bread (store bought, sealed and unopened) to accommodate my allergies and they DECLINED, because they are unwilling to work with customers who have disabilities. They then offered to make me a salad with cold cuts, to which I declined, because I'm pregnant and cannot have cold cuts. Unfortunate that these stores are unwilling to accommodate and are okay losing customers because of it. I will be reaching out to corporate, as this seems like a theme with this specific location.

Came here on a Tuesday night since it was taco Tuesday! I am vegetarian so I ordered the taco platter with the vegetarian tacos and double refried beans instead of beans and rice. I LOVE the veggie tacos, hands down best in the area, but my refried beans had a section with slices of pulled pork in it. My friend said she's never seen pork in the beans, and I don't think refried beans usually come with pork in them so maybe there was some contamination. I didn't finish them because they weren't that good, I've had better refried beans other places in Tampa. They were too salty and really lacked flavor. Good thing their tacos are good!!!
Great sushi, excellent service. That guy Michael that insinuated his son got food poisoning, seems to have bad luck as all his reviews are terrible experiences everywhere he goes.

Found a grasshopper in my food! A whole grasshopper that was cooked into the shrimp mei fun. Ordered lunch for the office for six people, but no one wanted to eat the food after the grasshopper was found. I asked for a full refund of all the meals, but they only refunded my meal. They did not clean or look into the source of contamination. They thought it was a bit gross and chuckled, but didn't seem concerned that a foreign insect was found in their cooked food.
Neglected to remove the peanuts from one of the dishes-my friend has a very severe allergy. The food itself was honestly fairly good. At least they took the dish off the order, lol.

I was a customer of this place on a Saturday night, where it was pretty packed. 30 minutes into my time being here i and my friend were thrown up on by another customer. It was a very uncontrolled atmosphere. Someone else threw up on us from being too drunk. No one from the establishment even came over to apologize to us, or better yet help us get someone else's VOMIT off of us. We had to get our own napkins and sit by this vomit for at least 10 minutes. When we went to leave, we were also overcharged, and they charge $5 per person to BYOB. No one from management apologized to us about having someone else vomit on us until we complained. Not a professional service at all. Service was also terrible to round it out ! Thank you for charging us $50 to be thrown up on :) Edit: after posting this they sent me this harassing message proving their professionalism :)

Don't come to Fellini if you are gluten free! Before coming to the restaurant we called and spoke to an employee about the gluten free meals. We were assured by the employee that there would be no issue finding gluten free options. However, when arriving at the restaurant there were only about 1-2 gluten free options in a 4 page menu and no gluten free pasta. When inquiring about gluten free options, many of the staff were unaware of which options contained gluten.

I can highly recommend NOT setting your expectations too high for this place. The service is lackluster and the food sounds great on paper but greatly lacks in freshness and quality. All of the good reviews make me wonder if the "locals" really know what good food is. I travel a lot and like to try the local places before the big chains so I was excited to find this place while visiting St. Louis. The menu had what sounded like some delicious options and seemed to have something for everyone. Even the reviews from what appeared to be locals were good (multiple visits, happy with everything on the menu). We checked-in online since it said the wait time was an hour. Once we arrived there were only a couple people waiting so we were seated within 5 minutes. However, that's when the night went downhill. It took extremely too long to get a drink that was ordered after the initial drink order. The food took forever to come out, but our server did inform us they were backed up in the kitchen and the food arrived shortly after. We were not impressed with any of it. I ordered the fish tacos with avocado, which was bland and definitely not fresh. It was served with rice and beans that were dried out, a single slice of slightly brown avocado on each taco and an overly spicy salsa I eventually used to add flavor to the greasy fish & boring slaw, which was really just a bunch of shredded cabbage. My mom had a similar review about the chunks of fish on her sandwich and my son's order came out with fries instead of kettle chips so he was brought a bucket of overly cooked plain chips, no seasonings at all! How can you mess up chicken nuggets and chips? Well they did because here I am writing a review at 3am with 2 sick kids!! That's right, they both have food poisoning from the chicken nuggets and my stomach is not feeling too good either!

The worst customer service. The staff have no idea what they are doing. I called ahead to make sure gluten free bagels were available. The person who answered the phone told me I didn't need to order them as they are always available. I listened to her. I came in today and was told they don't have bagels and more specifically the ones I inquired about weren't available all week. The staff was less than friendly or helpful. Won't be going back there.

Excellent There are thousands of places to eat and we ate there 2x. We had the chicken Alfredo..yummmmmmm Grilled crab cakes ...yummmm Servers Patrick was amazing and very attentive Place is new and feel clean No vomit smells like streets This place is clean Has a rooftop and the food is excellent

I had multiple problems with this establishment. The foreign woman who I assume owned the shop was rude from the start of my boyfriend and I being there. When I asked for a few add ons to my sandwich we both noticed that she gave me a piercing look that was quite startling honestly. Also her mask was on wrong. I've never been to an establishment where I felt that my food would be contaminated w something (spit, poison, etc.) especially during this pandemic. Never going there again. Also for two sandwiches it was close to $17. Spend your money elsewhere. Couples stay clear; ladies you don't exist, her eyes are on your man!

sushi was overall maybe a 7.5/10. service was okay. it took awhile for our server to take our order. i have a gluten allergy and i had no issues here. they have gluten free soy sauce but their house salad is not gluten free. miso soup was pretty good and a good amount. food came out pretty fast. it was just a decent sushi place if you're looking for some fast sushi. nothing special but nothing bad.

Food was very disappointing. First I ordered 2 different drink, both soda & they tasted flat the lady swore the soda comes straight from a can, but they both tasted like half water half soda & the soda was $3 when their cups don't give you a full can of soda. The noodles are made to be half cooked along with the egg being half cooked, but it doesn't taste good. I got the pork ramen and the flavor of the broth is subpar, the pork that I got was mostly fat so I really didn't have any meat in my soup. I was asking the waitress about everything in the soup as I have allergies & she seemed to get a little irritated that I was asking all these questions. It was horribly overpriced for not being so good, ramen is $16 but honestly I would've preferred the ramen from the store for 1.99!
It was so overpriced for nothing, bad quality food and my girlfriend got food poisoning from their tenders.

This places food tastes good but they give you only a little food, but that's ok. The employees told me that a certain thing on the menu was gluten free, so my mom ordered it. Sure enough, an hour after eating it she was very sick. She has an allergy. But the place is okay I guess.

There is a first time learning curve to this place with a predatory 'skimp you on your toppings' theme. You will get a skimpy made to order pizza unless you constantly ask for more. I wasn't afraid to ask, but I should have asked for more even after asking for more. If I had, this would be a solid 4 star review, but because of this, it won't be. Even if I go back and am happy with the results, it probably won't get an update of more than 3 stars. I'll explain why below. I ordered a high-rise made to order pizza. It's a bit costly for the size, but all the ingredients and the variety of the selection were good. I really liked the hot pizza sauce, which I had to ask for more. I asked for mozzarella, which looked like a decent amount, but after cooking was not enough. I ordered pepperoni... which the server put 6 pieces on, which I had to say, add more. I then asked for the salami, which the server only put on a few pieces. I had to ask for more. I then got mushrooms, which were not enough, I should have asked for more. I also asked for the grilled garlic, oddly I got enough. I asked for the pizza to be cooked well done, which I got. I was pleased with that. I ended up eating half the pizza there, but when I got home, how skimpy it all was became too apparent. There were just not enough toppings or cheese. It was like eating embellished bread... which leads me to my next paragraph. The dough. They offer all sorts of gluten free, normal crispy, vegan and high-rise dough and some other option I don't rememeber. I didn't get a chance to taste the others, but the dough was really bland. It could have used some salt. Or any salt. Or seasoning. Any seasoning. It just tasted like cardboard. The texture was nice, but that was about it. No sourdough option. No flavor at all. The hallmarks for a GREAT pizza place is having delicious crust you could eat alone. Properly salted, properly seasoned... the crust should be one of the highlights. Here, it was really disappointing. Along with the lack of toppings and the desire to completely skimp you unless you nag them for more toppings. I will come back some day... and I will have to forcibly assert my needs to make a decent pizza, because, left to their own, it's really not good pizza at all.

Always have LOVED the Mazzaro Experience until today. Got our Latte's and Sammy's, went to outside patio to eat then 2 people with dogs came out to eat. Had to leave..... Highly allergic to dogs in addition to not a fan of animals around my food. Two hours later my eyes are still watering!

The gluten-free pizza is quite possibly the worst pizza I have ever eaten. Not only was the crust bad, but they smothered it in sauce and barely covered it with cheese. $15 for this? Please. If you're not going to make a decent gluten-free substitute, don't bother. We would rather not have a substitute than suffer through a bad one.

We have been here three times, but this is the first time that I had a chance to review the location, food, and service. This location and menu is relatively well hidden because it's not on their main menu signage. In fact, you would only see it if you sat on the row and saw the modest card with the price and menu. At $35, yes $35, you can have the chef prepare you a delightful omakase. The meal varies each time based on ingredient availability and also the chef. Prior to this meal, we had come about 6 months ago, and had a phenomenal experience. The manager, Mindy, curated the meal for us. She let us know what was available and what was not. She also interacted with us throughout the meal and gave us some insight about each of the Dishes she was serving. She also asked about how we were doing throughout the meal. One of the really great highlights of that meal was a soft shell crab hand roll. Unfortunately, on this experience it was nearly the complete opposite. The chef interacted with us only to let us know about what was being served. Although he asked about our food allergies, he did not let us know that some of the items that were on the menu were not available including the uni. Fortunately, we did not want that uni but we expected to have something equivalent to that. We were taken aback when the final dish was a standard California roll. It was nice that some of the other nigiri dishes were doubled up to make up for what was lacking, but so many dishes were served at once that the Experience was lackluster, and felt rushed. I guess the secret is out now, but we don't plan on returning. We also asked the cashier about our previous experience with the manager Mindy, and were told that she, sadly, no longer work for the business.

We stopped here on our way to Houston TX. The grits with cheese were amazing! The herb omelette was super tasty. My chicken biscuit was delicious. We ordered a Caramel latte and the cappuccino was absolutely delightful. The abelskebers puffed pancakes with the caramel sauce was creamy & buttery. The service was excellent our server Megan was super attentive and accommodated my sister who has a seafood allergy. She was able special order items that were not cross contaminated. It was a over pleasure to dine at French Toast. We will definitely stop by again when we visit NOLA.

Cody's is hit and miss. We have friends who love it, but I'd always prefer to go elsewhere. Last night was a case in point. There were six of us - not a huge party. The place was half full, and we arrived around 6:00. Our waitress came to our table when she took our drink order, when she took our dinner order, when she delivered the food, and when she delivered the check. Not once did she come to check on us. It was fortunate that our six dinners came in two shifts because two of us ordered prime ribs cooked medium that were so under cooked that they were food poisoning waiting to happen. So, when the waitress came back to deliver the second round of dinners, we sent back our prime ribs. They were back out in about three minutes, clearly having been stuck in the microwave on high. They went from being inedible because they were raw to being inedible because they were worse than shoe leather. It's the last time I'm going to Cody's.

Just want to comment on "Michael G.'s" review. We were actually there on September 7th and seated RIGHT BEHIND THEM when their kid got sick. Why would THE RESTAURANT apologize for your kid throwing up everywhere? If you were implying he got food poisoning literally 5 minutes after eating their food, please try to make your story more realistic. You can't get food poisoning that fast. And since we were THERE that night, we had sushi and an entree from the kitchen and DID NOT get food poisoning. And according to Michael's other reviews his kid threw up at ANOTHER restaurant? Maybe instead of spending your time and energy posting bogus reviews for no reason, you can take your son to the doctor because he obviously has some dietary issues. I reported his bogus review and hope it gets deleted, because also, ew? Who posts photos like that to Yelp? Now, for the review of the actual restaurant. I have been going to this place for as long as it's been open. I have take-out ordered here MANY times and have dined here and It's always clean and the food is extremely fresh. It is one of (if not the best) place in Spring Hill for sushi. I think *one* time the service was a bit slow but not anything to complain about. We just dined here again tonight and the sushi was fantastic along with the service (and it was pretty busy). The restaurant is also very nicely decorated and hip. My only complaints are that the takeout orders do take longer sometimes and that they have recently hiked the prices up on their food. But there has never been any concern over cleanliness or taste of the food.

I'm throwing Stella Rossa three stars because I think (and hope) they can be better than what we experienced during our visit this month. We went for a huge birthday party that was set up with a prix fixe menu. They had three options for us to choose from, with two appetizers. I was eating a limited diet when we were so I asked to do a balsamic dressing on greens instead of the Caesar salad, which they were able to accommodate. And for dinner, all of the options were heavy pasta dishes so I asked if they had anything whole grain or gluten free. Again, they were able to accommodate. So props there. But overall, the food that came out to us was just not good. The rigatoni dish my boyfriend received had out of place pepperoni lining the dish and too much cheese (and he's a cheese lover). My pasta had a weak tomato sauce that was kind of watery with very little crab meat - just small shreds. Another reason I'm giving them three stars was the kind waiter who went out of his way to bring me mango sorbet since I had ordered the gluten free pasta and he assumed right that I was not eating the cake. It was a kind gesture and I appreciated the servers doing their best on what seemed to be a stressful night. But we just weren't impressed with the dishes we received, so we'll hesitate to go back. I would like to believe they'd be better for a smaller party. Here's hoping.

I found this place on yelp and decided to give it a try since we get a discount if we check in with yelp. The first time I was there it was great, I actually thought it was one of the best in Reno till the second time we went there. We sat at the bar and at first everything seemed to be going good, the chef was good and quick and food was alright till after I ate a really nasty bad fishy tasting unagi. I literally almost threw up but I didn't complain thinking it's just that one. We decided to order the salmon skin handroll as our last since the unagi threw us off and disgusted us and the salmon skin is fried. As we're waiting, the sushi chef has the nerve to ask us if we really want the handroll and we're like "yeah" then he goes, "we charge for any leftovers" and i'm like, "ok...what about the ones I don't like"? he's goes, "it doesn't matter" and I'm like, "even the one that's bad? and he keeps saying "it don't matter, you will have to pay full price for it" then I got upset and told him that the unagi was fishy and gross so I said, I'm not eating that nor am I paying for it. He goes, "well, that's insulting when you're saying the food I serve you is gross". He obviously wasn't understanding me. I'm insulted at the fact that I pay good money to be serve good, fresh food and should not have to be asked if I should stop eating. It's all you can eat for a reason! we were only there for about 30 mins and it wasn't his duty to charge me for leftovers, I'm well aware of that as its stated on the menu and if anything, the waiter should be the one telling us that, not the chef! Many sushi restaurant has that stated on their menu. However, they don't enforce it. This is the first and they obviously do, if they have the chef reminding you. We felt discriminated on as well. He was so nice and so helpful to the Caucasian lady and I felt that they served that bad unagi on purpose so we won't continue to eat. They were speaking Spanish to each other then all that happened. We will never step foot there again and I will be sure to spread the love on the horrible experience I had. Be aware if you decide to stop by. I wanted to complain to the manager but I felt he was in on it. Just horrible.

This place is awful. Horrendous. Atrocious. Putrid. Vile. Etc. I've never regretted going to a restaurant so badly in my entire life. We were on vacation, staying at the Gaylord Opry resort which is across the street from this place. We made reservations. Showed up 5 minutes early and still waited 15 minutes for a table. The place was not full, just seemed severely understaffed. When we were finally seated our waitress mixed all of our drink orders up. Some of us ordered our drinks in souvenir mugs and everyone in our party who did not order one in fact received them, and those who orders did not receive them. We ordered food, we could not physically even eat our meals. They were completely inedible. The fried chicken is microwaved from the likes of a TV dinner. Rubbery, spongey, black meat, drenched in grease. Not just typical fried food but as if they spooned grease on top... It was over cooked so badly none of us even ate more than a bite. The sides were frozen and re microwaved- I even got ice in my vegetables. The chicken had a lemony sour, old taste to it. Out of 4 people zero of us could eat anything. Avoid this place at all costs. We even told the waitress why we didn't eat anything and she just said "too bad, sorry about that!" When one of us asked for change our waitress brought back only large bills-- how can you tip with that? Seriously, this place is grimey and has food poisoning written all over it!
There are no gluten-free​ drink options except for​ an ​expensive glass of wine.
TOOOOO MANY NUTZ in the Brownie literally almost developed a nut allergy eating it. Flavor fantastic and everything else is too just calm down on the nutz next time.

If I could rate this place less than one star, I completely would. I have only been here like once before, and it wasn't horrible and it was lunch time.. My boyfriend and I decided we wanted sushi and I thought of Noburu (in hindsight, Ooka would have been the way to go..) so we headed on over. We were promptly seated, and it was surprisingly empty for a Friday night..warning sign one. We ordered our drinks and went over to the buffet. The sushi looked fine and they had a decent variety, however about two pieces in, I started to get a sickeningly weird taste in my mouth. I decided to try to get some hot foods instead, steering clear of their sushi selection (which you would think would be better--they have people making it in the center of the buffet, however it's a quality issue). All of the hot food? It was cold, chewy and disgusting. Now, I know asian buffets aren't generally known for going above and beyond in culinary skill, but this was HORRIFYING. I stopped eating immediately, and my boyfriend did as well, him only eating a piece or two more than I and us both staring at each other in disgust. I asked to speak with a manager, my tummy quite uneasy (from nausea, not because I was asking to speak with a manager). Our waitress sheepishly said she was the one in charge at the moment. I explained that I had eaten a few pieces of sushi, ordered a soda and I would be more than happy to pay for my soda, however the food was almost inedible and I felt like I was LITERALLY going to vomit. She walked away, and came back about ten minutes later (my boyfriend and I almost making bets on whether she was even going to come back) and flatly said there was nothing she could do. Before leaving, I asked the individual at the front if there was another manager I could speak with and he said no. I'm quite displeased, and I'm really not one to complain..especially about food. Walking out to the car, mid sentence, I did manage to break a world record in most projectile vomit in a lot. I will admit, it was impressive.. Needless to say, I'm disputing the charge with my bank. Honestly, save your time and money. $30 dollars wasted, projectile vomit in the parking lot, poor customer service, and throwing up until there was nothing else but stomach acid coming up when I got home...worth it for some sushi? No. Go to ooka, pay a bit more, and enjoy your food. Please. :( I'll even buy it for you to keep you from going here.

Sadly this place has disappointed me my last two visits. I've went back because I've always had a good experience however it was my mistake 2x over. I've notice that the grilled pork was reheated and not fresh as before. Both times I've had items that should have been hot both Luke warm or cold on several different items. Also lack of cleanliness caught my eye ..don't get me wrong I've seen this place when it was 100% all around. I've seen the good and now the bad. Also I did notice there is a lot of cross contamination with one person answering the phone, taking payments , serving food and also taking dirty dishes off of tables. I understand as a owner you have to multitask however do it in a clean manner. Sad to say I will look for another place to get my Pho and rice fix.

Have been to this place many times and very good. Unfortunately, we were there in early Dec and had food poisoning later that evening. Don't know if they changed management or chefs but can't go back after suffering thru! Sorry, they need to better control food spoilage and handling

This place was horrible!!! Please don't go there, I rather eat a TV dinner. A long wait for a nasty appetizer. The waitress lied and told me the appetizer was good.. they brought out the wrong appetizer. The chef who brought out the food looked horrible with long gold dread locs and raggedy mouth and could barely talk. The food took extremely long and tasted like it was out of the can. I do believe the shrimp were spoiled in my bbq pasta. We left hungry and sick. Once I made it home I vomit And had diarrhea for the rest of the night!!!! I don't know if they did this on purpose or what! The jambalaya pasta ,supposed to be crab dip,chicken finger,bBq pasta were all horrible and not eatable!!!!!! I'm sick now!!!

I went here with my husband in hopes of a nice meal. It is very small , but that didn't bother us. Problems started first in line while waiting to place our order. The "manager" (a woman not sure of her name ) was very rude to one of the workers there. Talking down to her and as soon as the worker walked away she ( the manager) was rolling her eyes and laughing about it with another worker VERY UNPROFESSIONAL. I ordered the veggie sandwitch ( I am a vegatarian) . When my sandwitch arrived I opened it up and the vegetables had obviously been cooked with meat. In fact there was meat in the sandwitch. When I brought the sandwitch up to the male manager he said " it is breakfast time and we are cooking bacon". When I placed my order it was breakfast time but the cashier told me it was okay to order their veggie sandwitch at that time. The manager said they could try to make another one but he wasn't sure it wouldn't have meat on it! I was in shock! I told him that if he couldn't guarantee that it wouldn't be cooked with meat then I wanted my money back which he did give back to me. I will say that the bake goods are yummy , but I will never go back. Between the rude staff (management) not the very polite young man and woman who come a long and clean your tables and the obvious lack of concern about cross contamination, they do not deserve my business.

Horrible staff, ranging from the host, barista, and most significant- our server. I brought a friend from out of town to this place. It was a horrible experience. I was so embarrassed that this "trendy" place was so rude and inexperienced with dietary restrictions/allergies. They were so dismissive to our questions about the menu even before we sat down. They are just stuck up acting. I tell EVERYONE to stay away from that place now.

Very disappointing. Had reservations outside and it took 25 minutes before anyone came over to take a drink order (after we mentioned to the hostess that nobody had come to our table). The waitress was cold and unapologetic when she came over to see us and after our taking our drink order, failed to bring our bottle of wine over. Two of the people in our party are gluten free and when we asked the hostess if they had any gluten free options she said they could custom make anything on the menu gluten free and they frequently make this accommodation for customers. However, the waitress told us that no gluten free options were available and the hostess overheard and responded "oh really". After 10 more minutes we decided to get up and leave since we still hadn't gotten our drinks. Do not recommend.

I love the food here, it makes for a different gluten free meal in unique surroundings. My only issue is the inconsistent opening hours, they frequently close early, and some weeks don't open at all. The owner/chef is very rude, has zero customer service ability, or maybe just didn't like me? But that is a true testament to the food, because you'll find me here once a month, grinding my teeth because I didn't get a simple hello, or putting up with the complaint that the visa charges are too high. This would be a great place for Gordon Ramsey to visit, she would even give him a run for the money.

Totally disappointing experience... have only had good food and service at other locations, this was our first time here and will be our last. Not only was our food mediocre, they totally screwed up the gluten free order -- taken off their gluten-friendly menu!! -- and brought a salad with croutons and other questionable items. Then the replacement took three servers asking questions (including the idiotic "How do you feel about cross contamination" to which I replied "I'm not a fan") and then the replacement meal took so long to come that my three companions had finished their meals. Plus my husband's order was wrong, however after the ridiculous drama over mine he decided to eat it and just move on. They comp'd my meal which seemed sub par in terms of compensation. Again didn't want more drama although our friends urged us to ask/expect more. First time I have EVER not left a tip for a restaurant meal...

after six months of anticipation, we got to GREKO last night. I have five words : under seasoned, over priced, and loud. 1. I had lamb pita and subbed the village salad for fries due to allergies. Feta on salad was good. Lamb was bland, pita was tough. 2. Restaurant was maybe 1/4 full, but the volume of music combined with low ceilings and cinderblock walls made conversation nearly impossible. I guess this makes for good customer turnover, but I couldn't stand that noise level for a whole beer. Overall, we were all underwhelmed and more than a little disappointed. Not a place to add to the regular rotation.

Absolutely awful. So the food and our Jenna was great but the manager, NOPE. So my friends got a cookie skillet which was advertised incorrrectly on the menu. My friend is allergic to nuts and after taking a bite we found out it had Heath bars in it. We had to Uber home so she could get some medicine. She ended up throwing up and feeling very sick all night and morning ruining our trip. When my friend had mentioned this to the server, Jenna,she wanted to fix the issue but the manager refused to take it off our bill. Awful customer service. If my friend was highly allergic to nuts we would've been in the hospital suing. Shame on you

If you have special dietary needs or allergies DO NOT EAT HERE! They will not substitute anything for what you are unable to eat, disregard your needs and still charge you full price, even if you ask them not to put what you can't eat on the plate. I have over many years frequented this restaurant and have been happy with the food and service.... until now. I have had to change my diet due to health reasons and found myself unable to eat the 'starchy' sides that were the options. I asked to get a little more salad (which comes with the meal) to makeup for not getting one of the sides I couldn't eat. I was told that the salad was complementary so they can't increase the size, which made no sense at all as the menu stated it came with salad and a choice of the 4 items I'm not allowed to eat. The description of the dish I ordered said that it came with sauerkraut or red cabbage, both items I could eat, so I requested that I get both or more of one to make up for not getting the 'starch' side. I was told 'No, we just don't do that'. The only reason we didn't leave then was because my friend had her heart set on schnitzel. I settled, and said to put the starch side in a separate bowl so I could give it to my friend so that at least I got the amount of food that they are charging me for. I thought the matter was settled, but when the salad arrived almost a quarter of what was on the plate was potato salad, which they already knew I couldn't eat and they didn't even tell me that when I ordered it, which was after clearly stating my food limitations. When I pointed this out to the waiter he just shrugged and offered no apology at all. What would have happened if I had a life threatening food allergy to a substance that I couldn't readily see? Would they disregard the information, serve it anyway and potentially risk a life? The food (that I could eat) was still tasty, the only reason I gave them any rating at all, but I will unfortunately not be returning because of thier inflexibility of accommodating my dietary needs.

This establishment was by far one of my worst experiences as a customer. After, entering the establishment and giving the hostess our name to be seated we waited about 2-3 minutes (great!). However, the individual who was going to seat us got our name incorrect and called it 2-3 times before realizing we were the next customer (we are not hard to miss). When we were finally seated, our server came to our table and took our drink orders (nothing complicated...coffee with cream and black tea with milk). By the time we received our beverages, she had mixed the cream and milk to the wrong customers. Plus the water glasses were not clean. Additionally, my mug felt grimy. Moving on to the meal was tragic. While we were ordering, our waitress was coughing up her lungs. I specifically asked her about the Apple Cinnamon Pancakes which include granola. I wanted to make sure that the granola did not have nuts in them because I am DEATHLY allergic to nuts and because granola has different ingredients. When I asked, the waitress about this, she acted put out and said, "It's granola". I attempted to explain to her that I was allergic and she said, "Let me ask". The granola did, but this was where I had made my decision I would not come back. By the time we finally got our meal, I asked the individual who served the plates if we could please have extra napkins. We NEVER received the napkins. I was done! Overall, we were in the restaurant for 1 hour and waited for our check for 20-30 minutes. The waitress never checked on us, we never received our check, and the floors were dirty where people were siting. There was a young man who was cleaning off tables with a dirty rag. Additionally, the serving staff WAS NOT DIVERSE. I did speak to Ashley (the manager) about our experience and discussed my displeasure in my experience. Our food was "okay", not something to write home about. I would NOT recommend this establishment to anyone.

Great for vegan, gluten free, and carnivores alike! I think it has potential but has room for improvement. It is designed to be a family style eating experience, with locally sourced ingredients. I think the atmosphere and layout appeared more upscale. The pricing was a little high for certain things. I do think they could do a better job listing how much of each thing is included. For example: I got the Thai vegan sliders, they came with 8, which is fine to share, but too much for me. My husband for the buffalo wings & only got 4 wings. His was listed as shareable between 1-2 people, but it barely fed one. They serve the food as it is easy. Which means my fries came out before my sliders, and all of it came out before our charcuterie appetizer plate. The Thai sliders were made of jackfruit which wasn't cooked all the way making it chewy. Similar texture to the tough part of an artichoke leaf. The charcuterie plate was super good but can easily cost a fortune. Each item is priced to the right, and you add what you want. The marinated mushrooms were easily the best thing we ate all night, I used the oil to dunk my bread in. The menu has a large vegan offering, with options to add meat if wanted. Fries are thick steak fries with hearty thick sea salt, very tasty. Tons of vegan sauces offered also. No vegan dessert. Photos aren't great because the lighting is dim, which adds to the ambiance. I plan to go a few times, as I think it will be phenomenal once they work out a few kinks.

I am at a loss for words. What IS IN THIS THAI TEA? This is not real thai tea. Real thai tea is mixed with cream and condensed milk. This was dispensed from a drink machine. It tasted like throw up. It was extremely acidic to the point i couldnt stomach it. It tasted beyond old and spoiled, not even resembling the taste of anything i've ever had, let alone "tea". I will NEVER return to this place and i want everyone to know that this place is NOT fresh. Take a look at the pictures yourself. W T F! I poured it down the drain...what a waste of money. Putrid, acidic, vomit tasting mess. If you want fresh, this is the wrong place.

Big let down. This is NOT traditional Japanese food if that's what you're expecting. Instead it's some innovative Japanese inspired hipster food. Dishes are outrageously priced for like 5 bites. They price the food like if you're going to a prestigious restaurant but the servers are very unprofessional. One boy that was serving was wearing pink shorts and a shirt covered with anime girls. Food is disappointing. And on top of it all it's made me very very sick, I've been fighting the need to vomit all night.

Oh my god. This place is so freaking good. I still cannot get over how amazing the food is here. We stumbled in here on a snowy weekend morning before they even opened, yet, the staff still allowed us to come in. I decided to try the renowned Cyprus Breakfast and I was not disappointed. Everything on the plate was awesome especially the fried cheese, however, after I finished about half, I could feel my entire body swelling from the salt; the feeling was that intense. I was stuffed from the Cyprus Breakfast and the fried potatoes (again, delicious!), but that didn't stop me from being seduced by the idea of dessert. I'm not a huge fan of baklava, yet I ordered it here believing it was probably the best baklava I could experience for awhile. Well, I basically licked the plate after I devoured it. Best. Baklava. EVAR. In addition to the food being awesome, it is also decently priced. The staff is also very friendly and nice. I HIGHLY recommend brunch at this place.

December 14th.......OMG!!! Worse decision ever......I was told the flounder sandwich here was ssssoooo great.....I ran thru drive through and got one.....waited till I got home 1mile away to look at it.-tarter sauce only-barely any on it....they grilled BEER INFUSED bun......bull it was black so that was burned and the fish patty I would say Mc Donald's is better. PLUS I've been throwing up since midnight Friday night it was possibly bad sandwich as in food poisoning. Will not go back

We had a great experience at this restaurant. It's easy to miss because it is right next to a huge Walgreens by the way. The decor is classy and upscale. Each table is set up on the left for an intimate experience if that is what you are looking for. We came here for a date night and to try some gluten free jerk chicken and rice and peas which is my favorite. The staff here is very very friendly and attentive. Not a second passed that someone wasn't checking on us to make sure we had everything we. needed. The owner works out in the front and he is friendly and speaks to everyone- very nice and talkative. His wife is the chef and she came out to assure me what items were free of gluten. I can not wait to return here! Our bill was either about 75$ or 100$ before tip- that was with 3 cocktails. Very affordable. The gluten free jerk chicken, oxtails, curry goat, and rice and peas were perfect. They had the right amount of spice and saltiness. They reheated the same the next day. They give you a lot of rice so I actually reheated that a few times and every time it tasted the same. The gluten free jerk chicken wings were my favorite out of all of the meat we had because they were spicier in my opinion and I really like wings.

Used to like this place until I got freaking food poisoning from one of their burgers. Now I'm spending New Years Eve incredibly sick and in bed all because they can't manage to properly cook a burger. Never ordering from/eating here again!

Family of 11 went to celebrate a birthday. Met Emil, very nice, runs a great staff. Our service was very nice. The "saddle up" was fun. Everyone enjoyed their food and the sangria was fantastic! The reason for my low rating is this: soy bean oil used in everything! Oil and vinegar salad dressing? Have you ever heard of using soy bean oil??? How about the Caesar Salad? Yep, made with soybean oil! Have they never heard of people being allergic to soy??? It greatly reduced the choices on the menu for me, thus it greatly reduced my enjoyment of dining at this restaurant. Still enjoyed the occasion, but with a round trip of 47 miles, I will definitely steer the group to a better quality restaurant.

Born and raised Texan here so I know what TexMex is and real Mexican is and this was not it!! Plain and simple gross was my experience. I ordered a beef enchilada plate- first they heated it up in a microwave (seriously watched them), the rice tasted like to rice from a box, it was just thrown on a plate that looked lIke someone threw up on it. It tasted just as bad!! The staff was rude when we weeny to sit down they yelled rudely to go to other side. I was confused because they didn't sAy that area was closed they just rudely yelled and pointed to other side. Would never recommend nor be returning!! Save your appetite go to Chuys down the road!!

A friend and myself decided to have an early dinner here about a week ago. The place was fairly empty on a Monday afternoon so we thought perfect, quick and easy service but no. Service was slow and the meal itself just wasn't good. Personally I ordered a create your own pasta with Alfredo sauce chicken and sausage while my friend had something very similar with chicken as well. Later on that same night we both had excruciating stomach pain which lasted another day. We called and told them this and they said sorry and that they'd do something special the next time we came in. Why would we return to a place that gave us possible food poisoning and all they could say is sorry?

This was the most disgusting burrito I have ever eaten. Tasted like there was something off about it like the ingredients had gone bad and had a moldy flavor. We Had the chicken burrito today. Threw half of it away. My girl friend threw her half away. And we were starving. I mean we didn't even finish this disgusting burrito while we were starving. I'm expecting to get food poisoning in about 10-12 hours. I ate here last time 15 years ago and the burritos were fresh and twice the size. You shrunk them, made them disgusting, lowered the ingredient quality and charge double. Shame on you. Can't wait until you go out of business and something decent opens up in their prime real estate spot.
The only good part was music from Trey Odell and the view. Server was not knowledgeable of what gluten free options they have. Friends fries were cold. Server forgot to put in one item we ordered

With the exception of the jumbo shrimp, rotisserie chicken and red mashed potatoes, most of the food being served on their hot food bars were luke warm at best, definitely within the unsafe, dangerous/hazardous temp range, an invitation for food poisoning. #1 - Golden Corral cooks couldn't prep nor cook food properly to save their lives. #2 - Most of the food looked old and greasy #3 - Salad ingredients appeared old and wilted, and were slimy (esp the cucumbers) #4 - Lemon cake containing anise tasted awful, a truly horrible combination of flavors #5 - While the ice cream was good (likely because it is not made in house!), many of the deserts were stale especially the macaroons, rice krispy bars, and cakes (except the carrot cake). #6 - The display pictures showed: 6oz sirloin steaks, but in actuality were 2-3oz and looked like scraps 1/2" slices of prime rib, but were cut paper thin - 1/4" The steak tagsticks that stated m.rare were well done; those that were marked rare were medium. #7 - The russet mashed potatoes had chunks of undercooked potato within. Eat herein at your own peril...

The waitress was fair. The cook was HORRIBLE, ABSOLUTELY HORRIBLE! My 12 year old son has a shellfish allergy and the cook did not take that very well when I told him that my son's food needed to be cooked separately or before everyone else's. The cook rolled his eyes and blew his breath when we explained to him how severe my son's allergy. The cook then proceeded to have an attitude as he explained to us how he would have to go all the way back in the kitchen to rearrange and to re-prepare all of the food. Not only did his attitude and rudeness upset me, but upset my family and especially my son as well. IT WAS MY SONS BIRTHDAY!!!!! The cook is EXTREMELY RUDE and needs to be fired for just his rudeness alone. He needs to be taught better etiquette and manners and they need to apologize for their rudeness. I am sure there are other people that have food allergies and they need to be able to handle it better. Also.., the floors were sticky, the place was dirty, there was grease covering the heater and the burner that looked like it had not been sanitized or cleaned. The bathrooms were unclean, there was bugs in the florescent lighting in the bathroom. This place was atrocious. Also the food was just awful and not cook the way you asked for it to be. I think that the BBB needs to come inspect this place and it needs to be condemned. RUDENESS is uncalled for, especially when you are paying almost 30 dollars a plate. Will NEVER come to this place again.

When I was a youngin, my momma and her baby daddy brought me to this establishment for my 6th birthday. There I sat, bright eyed and ignorant of the evil I was currently surrounded by. Employees covered in sin walked the aisles of my new hell. When my food arrived, and I cannot stress this enough, the putrid, shriveled, naked mole rat-esque hot dog that sat before me brought vomit to the front of my mouth. This hot dog yack-inducing and I would have rather had the local homeless man cut off his hot dog and serve it to me under the bridge.

I called to place a to go order so my wife could just come by and pick it up. We were willing to make that 30 minute drive. I was told they do not do to go orders on Sunday. So my wife gets there and calls me to tell me they have a limited menu which was not mentioned when I called about the to go ordering. She read the limited menu. I told her I would take the Eggs Benedict. She calls back to tell me she was denied that order to go. She drove from Arnold to get me gluten free food just to walk away with nothing. I called up there after hanging up with her and spoke with the same guy. His explanation for why she was denied was because the chef feels we should eat the eggs there because the quality will be ruined by the time we get it home. I am a chef and never in my life have I heard of such a thing. Your confidence should not prohibit this company from profiting. The chef should be confident enough to let a meal be to go. This cafe just lost $60 of food they could have sold and any future business. We won't be back. Thanks for the horrible service and being denied food.

I work around the corner and used to order from this location all the time. I hadn't ordered since March and decided to place an app order over the weekend. I get an automated text instructing me to text "curbside" and when I arrive and wait. I did so and waited 25 minutes past the time my food was supposed to be ready and no one has come out, and nothing is on the shelf. Finally I go in to check on the status of my order and the person behind the counter finds it and hands it to me. When I got home I realized the container with my stir fry is almost ice cold, and not only are there no noodles but I was only given uncooked, stir fry veggies. It does look like they tried to call but all I saw was a missed call from and unknown number with no message. I'm more confused about why no one came outside once the app alerted them on their end that I had arrived and just told me they didn't have noodles. I understand they likely could not make a substitution without my permission(due to potential allergies) but at the very least the vegetables could have been cooked. I honestly would have preferred for the item to be removed from my bill because I essentially paid 9 dollars for a cup full of frozen vegetables. Everyone behind the counter did look like they were busy, so maybe institute an easier way for employees to inform app customers that a substitution is needed.

I was excited to add this place to my list to have a drink for my first visit to Nashville. What a disappointment. Old decor and I did not think it was very Jimmy Buffety. We sat at the bar and nearby was a singer. He was ok. Did a couple of sing along songs. That was fun. Lots of drinks on the menu. I was surprised that they didn't have more of a selection of margaritas. A lot of their drinks had pineapple juice in them and I am allergic to pineapples. I ended up ordering a strawberry daiquiri. But asked the bartender if there was any pineapple in the margarita. I know they normally do not - but like I said there was only a few drinks that did not have pineapple in them. He asked if I was allergic and when I told him yes, he said he would wash a few things before he made my drink. Appreciate that! But when I got my drink? It had a pineapple hung on the rim of my glass. Hmmmm..... As for the drink it had to have been a virgin- could not taste the alcohol - not even a little bit. Same for the husband - could not taste the alcohol. 24 dollars for 2 drinks that weren't that good? I wouldn't recommend this place.

Update at bottom - got food poisoning for sure from the Chicken Korma. Original review: Man, what happened Kurry Shack? You were my go to! Right around the corner, always decent sized portions, food was hot, spicey and delivered with quickness. I ordered one of my usuals tonight - Chicken Korma, and basically got no chicken and a funky tasting curry. Has some extra tang to it in a bad way, something is off. And on top of that, literally the least amount of chicken I've ever gotten from them. 4.83 ounces, absolutely pitiful compared to other neighborhood Indian places, even compared to Kurry Shack 3 or 4 months ago this is just sad. I weigh and measure everything I eat for dietary reasons and Kurry Shack used to clock in with 6.5 to 8 ounces of chicken in the various curry dishes (Tikka, Korma, etc). I have an order from July clocking in at 7.7 ounces, and June at 6.5 ounces, among others in a similar range. This is barely 40 grams of protein. Really a damn shame as Kurry Shack used to have just phenomenal flavor and portions. UPDATE: Got EXTREMELY sick after eating this and leaving the review last night. Woke up this morning and I'm still sick. Will spare yelp the gruesome details but the aftermath of this rotten curry IS NOT pretty. Would avoid at all costs. Bumping the review down to 1 star for banishing me to the toilet for two days.

DON'T EAT HERE!! Terrible, don't go. Came here from out of town with some friends and got terrible food poisoning. 2 of us got excessively sick that night. Called the manager and nothing was done to remediate the situation. This was supposed to be a nice restaurant and I was so disappointed in the quality and management.

I would definitely put 0 stars if I could. The service of the restaurant was very rude and not present at all. The food quality was horrible, it was too chewy, soggy, wet, and bland! Not fresh at all! My group of 5 friends and I went, and 2 of us got stomach problems right after. One of them even threw up that night! The reason why I write this is that it's the summer time and food can go bad, and not good things and bad smells and health problems can happen... I really hope the restaurant changes these problems.

Absolutely the worst meal I've ever are there. First of all, the glasses weren't rinsed properly so my drink tasted like soap. Even bringing it towards my mouth you could smell a strong detergent odor. Took about 20 min to flag down waitress to get a new drink. My steak came out black. I ordered it medium rare. It taste like someone through it on top of a pile of charcoal briquettes. It was utterly nasty. My mashed potatoes had too much garlic on them, same as my husband's fries. I can see why they're on the bankruptcy list for 2020. When home I threw up & had diarrhea. So much for spending money to eat out. NEVER AGAIN.

So this is the pizza joint my son and I hit up. Here's what they do right, they make the pizza per instructions listed in all Domino's. They get your order right consistently. They have a drive thru so I don't have to get Covid. I feel like Kevin from Home Alone when I come here because I'm always getting a cheese pizza, but the cheesy bread dipped into some marinara is also dope. If you've seen my other posts, you know that the wife and daughter are GF, don't do this option here they can't comprehend cross contamination, and I don't expect the teenagers here to either, BDP! (If you know you know), save GF option for Molipazzo. Domino's keep being you and I'll keep patronizing your fine establishment.

I've eaten here several times, and it's rarely a consistent experience. First, the food: It's decent diner fare, with a good selection of breakfast, sandwiches and burgers on the menu. Omelettes tend to be overly cheesy and greasy, and fries are limp and oily. Most of the burgers I've had are dry, but I appreciate their gluten-free selection and I love the milkshakes. The service is also inconsistent. Often, I get attentive wait staff, with servers who are happy to make recommendations. But today, it took more than 30 minutes for the waitress to bring us a menu. We were there for more than an hour before we got our food, and we never got silverware. I know they were busy, but a half hour to get menus is a little ridiculous. In short, head there if you have time to spare, and don't pass on the shakes.

Thanks to Christopher V. for the recommendation! My friend wanted whole shrimp while in NOLA, and have it he shall! Mr B.'s filled that fix. On a weekday afternoon, it was full to the brim of business people dining, I felt a little under-dressed because all of the servers were quite dressed up! However my fellow diners varied from casual tourist attire to nicer business casual. My friend loved his BBQ Shrimp and couldn't stop lopping up the sauce. I'm allergic to shellfish so went with the Tuesday Lunch special - Skip's Fried Chicken & Mac. This portion was absolutely huge and I didn't come anywhere close to finishing it. Especially since it came with a soup to start and we also received hot bread for the table. The dish came with a heaping portion of macaroni & cheese and collard greens. The sides were fine, mac & cheese a little watery, but overall no issues. The entire meal for me was just fine, though I must say service was excellent throughout! I think had I had their signature dish of the full shrimps in BBQ sauce, I would have loved this place. And I liked it just fine, wouldn't hesitate to dine there again, but $21 for my meal was rough...and that was on a lunch deal! Only because my recent comparison was the mind blowing chicken with the same sides from Willie Mae's which was half the price.

This place is horrible. Against my better judgement I got a chicken cheese steak for lunch. OMG!!! It was so salty. I totally got food poisoning later on in the day. And this coming from a man who has a cast iron stomach. I do not recommend this place.

As a big fan of the TV show "It's Always Overcast in Pittsburgh," I was saddened to see that this bar was actually not a run-down filthy dive replete with dead rats on the bar-top, grease stains on the walls, vomit on the floors, and broken glass in the drinks. It was a cozy, safe, family-friendly bar with a great beer selection and prices, as well as attentive bartenders. Which, as I said, is extremely disappointing. Maybe Danny DeVito can open a really stank, disgusting bar in Philadelphia that nobody would feel good about bringing their children or grandparents to - a place which would actually create the need for some "Charlie work".

If it weren't for the unexpected lactose intolerance that evidently all four members of my group developed just prior to eating all 12 inches of BlackThorn's globulously cheesy Chicago-style pie, this would be another star. The pizza, still, if you take a gas-x, is 4 stars. The bar, tho? One of my favorite atmospheres in St. Louis. What more could "my bar" possibly have than a bartender with personality, a shuffleboard table, and darts? Well, it could be totally divey! Here's all I have to say - I wish I lived next door. This would be my home.
Food poisoning from carne asada tacos, wish I could give negative stars. 0 chance I ever go back/ever recommend to anyone.

I love diners, and this place is a true, old-fashioned, great-food diner. My significant other and his Mom and Mom-Mom have been going here for years and continue to love it, for both the memories and the food. Each meal I've had has been delicious; however I've only ever ordered breakfast food. I'm one of those people who goes to a diner SPECIFICALLY to have breakfast for dinner, and this place has yet to disappoint. The only reason I'm giving it 4 stars is because I was told not to eat here during the summer. Both my BF and his friend have eaten here in the summer multiple times and have gotten food poisoning. It was from eating a meal with chicken in it, and their theory is that the due to the heat, the meat may be left out for too long and subsequently go bad, making them sick. Unfortunately, this wasn't just a one time thing, it happened to each of them a few times during the summer, so we reserve our visits to this diner for the cooler seasons. I personally have never gotten sick nor have I ever had a bad meal, but knowing that information, I felt that it warranted a star less as well as a warning to the owners to make sure the meat is being properly chilled during the hotter weather. I haven't let this stop me from eating my breakfast-for-dinner, and I don't plan on it stopping me either :)

I'm extremely lactose intolerant so I always order online so I can make sure there's no dairy in my burrito and all three times I've done that at this taco bell there's still cheese on my burrito. I've literally never had that problem before at the taco bell I used to go to back home but whatever I won't come back.

Still 1 star. Horrible deli service. Opens @ 7 am and they were 100% not prepared &750 when I came in. Waited for a very long time. Got a rude employee who tried to ignore me when I asked for help. Started making a sandwich before I even said what I wanted, which was a breakfast burrito. No bell peppers, no potatoes, rude about it & no discount. Very disappointed in this service. The other lady from the far side of the deli yelled "it is what it is" and I asked what's going on? She said they were short staffed and no delivery "yet". Still, not my fault and they could at least be polite about it. Man making my burrito yelled and threw up his hands about not having "anything" ( despite them literally being in a grocery store). Ugh not a great way to start a Sunday.

Horrible service. I was recommended this place for good gluten free food to try in the area, so I came in by myself on travel and asked for a seat at the bar (which was completely empty) just to be told they only do reservations on Fridays and Saturdays and could not accommodate one single walk in person for a glass of wine and food. I ubered here alone and was very upset I couldn't even try their food and had to uber again somewhere else just to have dinner alone. Would have understood reservation only for the restaurant but not an empty bar area. Won't give them another chance next time I'm in town. Hope their service improves.

Worst place ever!!! Does not even deserve a star. I Went there with a group of people. I had an allergic reaction to their food. Not sure who is cooking this food but there must of been a cross contamination because I am allergic to shellfish and some how Shellfish touched my plate. Maybe a spoon. My insides felt like they were burning and I was sweating. Thank god I took a Benadryl My bill was over $100 and they took a dessert that was $8 dollars off. Service was poor. Manager never came over to see if I was ok and staff cold care less on what was going. Never ever going back.

MY ORDER: Fish and 2 chicken combo. with drink. RESULT: The idiot at the window said they had no more soft drinks left except Mt Dew and Diet Pepsi. ORDERED Mt Dew Also, told me no mac and cheese left, so my sides were the corn and mashed potatoes and gravy. Got home: FISH, 2 Chickens were dark brown, so tough I couldn't bite through any of the 3 pieces. It'll be a miracle if I'm not food poisoned. The corn was so cold I think it came directly from Freezer and they never even chucked it in the microwave. The MT Dew was more like Club Soda, had no flavor just carbonated salt. The Hushpuppies were hardened and a coloration I've literally never seen before.. I took one bite and had to spit it out. THIS PLACE IS NOT ONLY NOT RECOMMENDED, IT IS DANGEROUS TO EAT.. You'd be better off just picking something out of a dumpster. They stole $11 from me. Never will go near this disgusting filth again. None of those kids working there care if you like the food or it kills you either. STAY AWAY

please offer more nut free options and please please make sure the employees are aware of what foods contain nuts! i came in and noticed there was a sign with a nut allergy warning so i asked an employee serving the food if all the foods contain nuts and she told me "not all of them." so i proceeded to order what she said did not contain nuts: the lasagna and mac & cheese. got home & was so excited to have vegan soulfood but instead i had a terrible allergic reaction. very sad about the incident because i love the concept of this restaurant but i am too scared to ever return again. ):

I have been here a couple times since I like the Double tree Hilton that's attached. I'm gonna review mainly based on my recent visit. I started with the Philly Fries, it sounded great, basically a deconstructed philly cheese steak on french fries. How could it be bad?? Well, it wasn't bad, just very, very average. The "steak" on the fries tasted like steak em, very very, very average tasting. It had lots of cheese and peppers, but the flavors were just blah. Unless I was starving I would not order it again. In the past I had their ahi tuna app, and it was really good. I was shocked how good it was to be honest, so to have a great tuna app, and to then have an average Philly cheesesteak fri, very confusing. For my meal I had the "Devils Cut BBQ burger", it was pretty good. For those looking for Gluten free options, go elsewhere. There was little to nothing on the menu. And when I asked, they looked at me like I had lobsters crawling out of my nose. So I just bit the bullet and ordered a burger. I would give the food a 2.5, but the staff has been great both times I've been here. That's why I rounded up. If you're in a pinch and don't want to drive, this place is ok. If you're looking for options and high quality food, you should probably go elsewhere. It's, so, so here. BUT great place to hang out and have drinks if you're staying at the Hilton.

New Day Gluten Free is a true sanctuary for those of us who can't process wheat like the rest of you lucky folks. There's even a sign on the door stating no outside food can be brought in, to ensure the environment isn't contaminated! Indeed, New Day is 100% wheat-free. Visiting their new location had topped my bucket list for the last couple of months, as they were moving their previous shop to a shiny, larger location in Clayton. And what a gorgeous space it is! Just going on 3 weeks new, we snatched the last open table on a busy Saturday. Nothing can prepare you for the beauty that lies in the glass-encased baked good display case. Generously frosted cupcakes, gooey butter cookies, lemon bars, the cutest cakes and much more! I ordered a carrot cupcake and lemon bar to-go for my mom and me, and for lunch we opted for a turkey club and a California melt. While both sandwiches were outstanding, I think my mom was a bit envious of the warm bun that hugged the overflowing toppings of my sandwich. Fresh turkey, provolone cheese, a liberal spread of guacamole, onions, lettuce and some mayo. But THAT BREAD! Wow. Just as good as bread made with conventional flour. This was my favorite type of sandwich in my gluten-eating days, so it was a dream to take in. After suppressing the temptation for a solid 8 hours, I finally gave in to the decadent carrot cupcake that had been staring me down all day. Holy cream cheese frosting! That was definitely the highlight for me and then some, as the cake portion was slightly dry. Still, it was one of the better gluten-free desserts I've had. Next time, I'll be trying the vanilla cupcake as that's my usual go-to treat. Thanks for filling in a much-needed void in St. Louis, New Day! You've earned some new lifetime fans.

Let me preface by saying I have not eaten here. I looked at their menu online, and they don't have gluten free options listed on the menu. No problem if they don't. I don't expect the world to cater to my needs, but eager to try it because the location is so close to us, I decided to call and speak to someone about possible options since the menu doesn't specify. I spoke with a woman and when I asked about this, she went to check. Fine so far. She came back to tell me she doesn't "think" there is anything gluten free on their menu. I question this so she goes to ask the manager. Comes back, manager says everything's gluten free. I kid you not. The flour tortillas and everything. My problem is not whether or not they have gluten free options but my problem is what kind of new, modern establishment doesn't know their food or understand their menu? This is concerning. The employees and manager clearly don't even know what gluten is, which is one of the most common food sensitivities today. Again, concerning and a no go for me. I have different expectations for restaurants with chefs and in popular areas than I would for a hole in the wall eatery in the middle of no where, and I can tell that this place wouldn't meet mine. Reading a few other Yelper's reviews, there seems to be some signs of laziness here, which is what I received on the phone (nonchalance and lack of caring). This is a turn off. As you move forward Loco, learn the food you are serving us and train your employees to do so.

Maddening. This should be a 4.5/5 star review. Nashville is at a tipping point when it comes to bars/restaurants. I have heard time and again how difficult it is to find/keep good FOH/kitchen talent but doing so is essential to the business plan. I don't want this city to fizzle out when there's so much potential yet to be tapped. The fact of the matter, though, is when you're asking the buying public to dole out significant dollars, you have to be on top of your craft every time. You do. My first experience at Ellington's came during their first week. I was (pleasantly) stunned by how well they tapped into the '70s cool of that era's James Bond, Hart to Hart, The Rockford Files, etc. Rather than depressing, the brass, browns, wood paneling, and large plants set a mood. This was punctuated by the music/muzak. My mood was further elevated by the menu. The choices of classic and signature drinks were well-curated (here, it makes sense to go with the classics). I was happy with my feta/watermelon appetizer and the shrimp & grits were delicious. Despite not having gluten-free desserts, I enjoyed the 1970s-era cups my post-meal coffee came in. I left happy. Very happy. Then, I came back the following week and the wheels fell off. This time around, the place was busier but not so busy that you couldn't sit. We were warmly greeted by the hostess from the previous week. Rather than being seated by the window (by the patio), we were seated by the wood paneling/mirror banquette. Fine so far. I liked having the new perspective of the dining room. I spied my waitress from the previous week and it looked like we were in her section. Nice! Hopefully she remembered my generous tip. And then we sat. And sat. And sat. We stared awkwardly at each other. My guest started to get annoyed and I got embarrassed. No one interacted with us. We weren't given so much as a glass of water. We felt extremely unwelcome. Finally, our hostess came by with water and a smile... but that was it. The waitress from the previous week who was being so gracious and charming with other tables twisted her body so as not to have to acknowledge us. Again. We sat. And sat. And sat. By this time, I am past being embarrassed. I am angry. A floor manager finally comes by to take our drink order. She says that she put too many covers in our server's section and that was the reason for the protracted delay. A few things about that: 1.) A lot of covers =/= being unable to stop by the table and say, 'Hi, folks. I'll be right with you and I'll have a runner drop some water off to you. Thanks!' 2.) There were other servers/runners in our section joking with and serving customers (who arrived before and after we did). 3.) No mention of 'Let me get you started with some drinks/apps on the house. So sorry for this mix up.' None of these things happened. Rather, after a tepid excuse for being treated like filth and watching our server - the same server I over-tipped the previous week - treat other guests with professionalism, I decided to leave. I went to the host stand, informed them that they could cancel my order and that we were leaving. In the midst of this, who should arrive? Our server. For the first time. Nope. Please continue to ignore us. You were doing that so well. The floor manager took my name and number and offered to have a manager call me. I left Ellington's and retired to the Fairlane lobby. I noticed two people from the restaurant had followed me down there but neither engaged. I used my Yelp app to find another eatery, left and have no plans on returning. It's a shame.

Do you not ever come here! I got the worst food poisoning of my life! I did up going to the hospital they told me that there was worms. I called the shack to tell them just in case for future reference and in the shed started yelling at me over the phone. I do wish I could give this I Stabley Schmidt zero stars because of how I was treated in the illnesses I received. If you're on the way to go eat here right now I really hope you reconsider.

WARNING Last weekend I went to pokeworks. I was so excited because I love pokè. About an hour later, I was violently vomiting from seafood poisoning. I ended up staying in the hospital for 2 days, and the hospital said it was definitely seafood poisoning. I was on an IV for 12 hours. It was HELL. So.... just a heads up if you decide to go to pokeworks.

I wasn't impressed. The bison burger was good but not very sizable for the price (I felt like it was a 5 bite burger). Everything is supposedly made with peanut oil (so those with allergies avoid the fries at all cost)...which contradicts what I was informed but both the server and manager said there is...So it could have been an amazing experience with fries...but alas :( I will say that regardless of the food hiccup (because what's a burger without fries) the atmosphere is perfect for an evening beer or bourbon with the buds!

One of my go-to's for classic Italian food done right!
